id: 29_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Replace the wire feeding nozzle
title: 激光焊接机更换送丝导嘴（国内版）
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/29_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Replace the wire feeding nozzle.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/29_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Replace the wire feeding nozzle（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 送丝管卡扣端装可换导嘴

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个小小的铜色导嘴，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a tiny knurled brass wire feeding nozzle and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲送丝导嘴怎样更换。
overlay: 激光焊接机更换送丝导嘴

shots.scene: 阿杰换了一卷粗焊丝，焊丝卡在导嘴里出不来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student has loaded a thicker wire spool, but the wire jams at the small brass nozzle.
shots.narration: 阿杰换了粗焊丝，送丝却老是卡住。

shots.scene: 小研拿起导嘴看了看，摇摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up the nozzle end of the feeding tube, looks at it and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研一看：导嘴没跟着换。

shots.section_title: 送丝管卡扣端装可换导嘴
shots.scene: 送丝管两端：一端普通，一端带卡扣和铜导嘴
shots.prompt_en: A wire feeding tube laid out on the bench: one plain end, and one end with a clamp and a brass nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝管带卡扣的这一头，
overlay: 送丝管卡扣端装可换导嘴

shots.section_title: 送丝管卡扣端装可换导嘴
shots.scene: 铜导嘴特写，旁边一个旋转箭头
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the brass nozzle with a circular arrow showing it can be unscrewed. No people.
shots.narration: 装着一个可以拆换的导嘴。

shots.scene: 两个铜导嘴并排，一个孔小一个孔大
shots.prompt_en: Two brass nozzles side by side, one with a small hole and one with a larger hole, each with a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 导嘴有两种规格，孔径不一样。

shots.scene: 细导嘴连着两卷细焊丝，粗导嘴连着两卷粗焊丝
shots.prompt_en: Lines link the small-hole nozzle to two thin wire spools and the large-hole nozzle to two thick wire spools. No people.
shots.narration: 每种规格对应两种焊丝直径。

shots.scene: 老李按住回抽键，焊丝退回导嘴里
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the retract button and the wire tip withdraws into the nozzle.
shots.narration: 换导嘴之前，先把焊丝回抽进去，

shots.scene: 老李关掉焊枪上的送丝使能开关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer flips the wire feeding enable switch on the welding gun to off.
shots.narration: 再关掉送丝使能。

shots.scene: 换导嘴时焊丝突然送出扎到手的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of wire suddenly shooting out and poking a hand during a nozzle change, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 免得焊丝突然送出来扎手。

shots.scene: 老李看焊丝盘上的空白标签，再看导嘴
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the blank label on the wire spool, then looks at the nozzles.
shots.narration: 先看清焊丝的直径，

shots.scene: 老李拧下旧导嘴，拧上对应规格的导嘴
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unscrews the old nozzle from the tube end and screws on the matching one.
shots.narration: 拧下旧导嘴，换上对应规格的。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着空白说明书上的一张小表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a small blank table in the manual.
shots.narration: 规格对应关系，查说明书的对照表。

shots.scene: 焊丝顺畅地从新导嘴伸出，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The wire comes out smoothly from the new nozzle, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 规格对了，送丝就顺畅。

shots.scene: 新导嘴的圆孔和磨损导嘴的椭圆孔对比
shots.prompt_en: Close-up comparison: a new nozzle with a round hole and a worn nozzle with an enlarged oval hole. No people.
shots.narration: 导嘴用久了，孔会被焊丝磨大。

shots.scene: 焊丝在磨损的导嘴里晃动，偏离红点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the wire wobbles in a worn nozzle and drifts away from the red dot. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝会晃，丝也对不准光点。

shots.scene: 老李把磨损的导嘴放进废件盒，换新的
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer drops the worn nozzle into a scrap parts box and takes out a new one.
shots.narration: 发现磨损变形，就及时换新。

shots.scene: 导嘴装歪，激光打在铜导嘴上反射出去的示意图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crooked nozzle puts the wire off center, the beam hits the brass nozzle and reflects away. No people.
shots.narration: 导嘴装歪，光可能打到铜导嘴上。

shots.scene: 铜表面像镜子一样反光的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a shiny copper surface reflecting light like a mirror. No people.
shots.narration: 铜很反光，反射的激光同样伤人。

shots.scene: 老李把导嘴拧正拧紧，丝尖正对红点
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer screws the nozzle straight and tight; the wire tip lines up with the red dot.
shots.narration: 导嘴拧正拧紧，丝尖对准红点。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着封面有激光标志的空白小册子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank booklet with a laser warning pictogram on the cover.
shots.narration: 激光防护以现行国家标准为准。

shots.scene: 小研在空白耗材登记本上写字，旁边一盒导嘴
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in a blank consumables logbook beside a box of nozzles.
shots.narration: 导嘴、焊丝这些耗材，领用要登记。

shots.scene: 登记本旁浮现日期、数量、签名三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Beside the logbook float three icons: a calendar, a number counter and a signature line. No people.
shots.narration: 记下日期、数量和领用人。

shots.scene: 欣欣身后浮现几个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands with icons behind: a retract arrow, two nozzles, a worn hole and a straight nozzle with a red dot.
shots.narration: 先回抽，对规格，看磨损，装端正。

shots.scene: 阿杰的焊丝顺利送出，他竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The wire now feeds smoothly through the new nozzle and the young male student gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰换对导嘴，送丝顺畅了。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 小零件，大讲究。下次见！
